reflection: Volume-relative factors (AAPL/NVDA volume z-score) are the only consistent winners; most others help in 2023 and 2025 but fail in 2022 and 2024, so they are regime-dependent. Close-location and QQQ-based ratios fail repeatedly. I will try volume-ratio variants with different partners (AAPL vs MSFT volume in different form, rank-like clipping), the NVDA-gap factor with a longer horizon to cut noise, and new ideas around the Apple range position vs its own recent range and open-to-close persistence. Partners will pair with the AAPL/NVDA volume z20 factor and with the vol-scaled gap using different roles.

lessons.name: log_aapl_nvda_volume_ratio_change_5d
lessons.lesson: Differencing the z-score removed the level information that made the parent useful and left mostly noise, hurting both models.

lessons.name: log_aapl_qqq_volume_ratio_z20
lessons.lesson: AAPL/QQQ volume ratio does not carry the NVDA-specific information and lost badly in 2022 and 2024, so the NVDA denominator is what matters.

lessons.name: nvda_aapl_return_gap_vol_scaled
lessons.lesson: Vol-scaling the NVDA-AAPL 3d gap helped both models in 3 years but failed in 2024, and it only adds in pairs with volume factors.

lessons.name: aapl_down_day_volume_share_10d
lessons.lesson: Volume-weighted open-to-close share overlaps with 10d momentum and added only noise on every team.

lessons.name: qqq_close_loc_5d_mean
lessons.lesson: QQQ close location duplicates QQQ 5d return and carries no extra signal for Apple.

lessons.name: aapl_minus_qqq_volume_surge_gap
lessons.lesson: It helped only in 2023 and 2025 as another volume-surge variant overlapping team members, so it adds little on the team.

factors.name: nvda_aapl_return_gap_vol_scaled_5d
factors.hypothesis: The 3d gap with 20d vol failed in 2024 probably from noisy short window; a 5d gap over a stable 60d vol should reduce noise while keeping the lead-lag signal.

factors.name: log_aapl_nvda_volume_ratio_z20_smooth3
factors.hypothesis: The parent failed in 2024 likely due to single-day volume noise; smoothing over 3 days keeps the relative-volume level but reduces spikes, giving a more stable signal.

factors.name: aapl_open_to_close_vs_qqq_3d
factors.hypothesis: Intraday Apple return relative to QQQ over 3 days captures session-level relative strength excluding overnight gaps, a distinct signal from close-to-close moves.

factors.name: aapl_high_distance_20d
factors.hypothesis: Distance below the 20-day high measures drawdown state, which may relate to rebound probability differently than moving-average distance.

factors.name: msft_nvda_volume_ratio_z20
factors.hypothesis: Peer-vs-peer volume rotation describes sector flow state, complementing Apple-specific relative volume by showing whether NVDA volume dominance is sector-wide.

factors.name: aapl_range_expansion_vs_nvda_volume
factors.hypothesis: Interaction of Apple range stress and relative volume gives Apple's own state that conditions the NVDA-lead gap signal, targeting regime dependence.
